name: Chronormu
summary: In the Western Plaguelands, Chronormu works to mend time's damaged threads. Mortals know her as Chromie, a bronze dragon who often works beside them.

sections.title: A Dragon in Small Guise
sections.body: Mortals know Chronormu as Chromie, an eccentric and cheerful female gnome. She belongs to the bronze dragonflight and serves Nozdormu, the Timeless One. The titans charged bronze dragons to guard history and correct disruptions in the timeways. In her gnome form, Chronormu walks among mortals as an approachable and optimistic peer.

sections.title: Watcher of the Plaguelands
sections.body: Among Lordaeron's ruined remains, Chronormu watches over the devastated Western Plaguelands. The kingdom's fall and the Scourge's spread tore at the region's history, leaving temporal anomalies and trapped remnants. From places such as the ruins of Andorhal, she works quietly with mortal adventurers to mend tangled timelines and investigate disturbances. Only when necessary does she reveal the full majesty of the dragonflight.

faq.answer: No. Chromie is Chronormu's mortal guise; she is a bronze dragon. Bronze dragons take mortal forms to walk among younger races without causing undue fear or suspicion.

faq.q: Why does Chromie have two names?
faq.answer: Chronormu is her true name as a bronze dragon. Among mortals, she uses the shorter name Chromie in her gnome guise.

faq.q: What is Chromie doing in the Western Plaguelands?
faq.answer: The Scourge's devastation of Lordaeron disrupted history and the timeways. From the ruins, Chromie investigates temporal anomalies, undoes historical disturbances, and enlists trustworthy adventurers to repair damaged threads of time.

Led by Nozdormu, the Dragon Aspect, the bronze dragonflight was blessed by the titans with power over time's pathways. Its members protect those pathways and intervene when time is altered or corrupted, so history unfolds as intended.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may meet Chronormu as Chromie, a cheerful figure whose small form hides a bronze dragon.
As a mage studying chronomancy, you may find Chronormu's casual command of time and localized temporal pockets fascinating, and staggering in scale.
